content: श्रथ् I. €1 €9 <ab>P.</ab> (श्रथति, श्रथ्नाति) To hurt, injure, kill. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> (श्रथति, श्राथयति-ते) .²1 To hurt, kill. .²2 To untie, loosen, liberate, release. --III. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (श्रथयति-ते) .²1 To make efforts, be occupied or busy. .²2 To be weak or infirm. .²3 To be glad.
